verdict.rationale: Productboard publishes a per-endpoint API reference at developer.productboard.com/reference (e.g., webhook create/list/delete pages). It also documents a quickstart for making a first live API call and an official 'Explore with Postman' path for running requests. However, nothing shows the reference itself is interactive (in-page try-it console) or embeds runnable examples, and execution relies on Postman. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser interactive try-it console, embedded runnable code samples on reference pages, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Get up and running with the Productboard API v2 in Postman in under 5 minutes.
In just a few steps, you’ll authenticate, send a request, and see real data come back.
Creates a new webhook subscription to be actively notified on each change in the specified entities.
